title: Minstrel shows and concerts
summary: He names minstrel shows he toured with, their mixed audiences, and the extra-charge concert after the main show.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We had a gang of shows.
Can you remember? It doesn't have to be in any special order which one you went to next. I know you can't always remember that.
Can you remember some of the names of the other shows or stars?
Well, yeah. J.C. Lincolent's Mighty Minstrel Show, Nailer's Mighty Minstrel.
These minstrel shows, were those mostly for colored or white audiences that you had then?
Well, they were colored and white.
Whenever you'd be on the road, you'd just...

That's right. Colored and white. You see, you'd play the main show, and then after the show there would be a concert for featuring a blues singer or something like that. You had to have a special act for the concert, you see?
Because they would always charge extra for the concert.
Well, now, the last show, the last minstrel show I was with was, I think that was in 1937. When I was with Brobby Rastus, that's the same show that Bessie Smith was on.
See? And we were together, I mean, when she...
